resources.string: Satark is watching for scam patterns
Stop. This may be a scam.
Do not send money or install anything. Tap to see why.
You have been on a long video call with someone you do not know. Tap to see why.
You asked to turn it off and the waiting time is over. Open Satark to turn it back on.
The guard against removal was switched off. If someone told you to do this, stop and call a person you trust.
Several numbers you do not know have texted you in a few minutes. Do not open links, share an OTP or pay anyone. Tap for advice.
